svg.text: Android template · plugins and module dependencies
Gradle 9.7 · AGP 9.4.0 · Kotlin 2.4.10 · JDK 25 (daemon + toolchain) · configuration cache · settings: includeBuild("build-logic"), foojay, TYPESAFE_PROJECT_ACCESSORS
Arrows mean “applies”; below each name, what it configures
Full IDs: convention.<name> · AGP/KGP are compileOnly; the root build.gradle.kts provides the classpath (apply false)
Color shows the convention plugin applied
extra plugin applied in the module (ksp, android.flavors)
Features get model, useCase, analytics and common through the android.feature plugin. google-services and crashlytics are declared in the root build but commented out in :app.
